changes.text: The unpaid bills notice is now shown only to the owner and key holders. Admins walking through a garden and visitors let in by the doorbell or a raid no longer get it
Key holders without the pay bills permission now also get the unpaid bills notice when they enter an MLO home
Parking a car that is not registered to you or anyone with garage access now says so, instead of showing "You are not allowed to do that"
Garage messages no longer push the button out of the slot card, and the selected card's bottom edge is no longer cut off

entries.title: Instant power cuts, door locking and IPL style fixes

changes.text: Power cuts from unpaid bills now happen instantly: when a new bill starts the cut, the lights go out for everyone already inside, and paying turns them back on at once, with no need to leave and re-enter
Changing an IPL home's interior style no longer leaves the furniture invisible (you could still bump into it)
Locking a placed door now swings it shut first and then locks it, instead of locking it half open or snapping it closed. A door someone holds open is forced shut after a moment
Lights you added yourself now also go out during a power cut
The power cut now works in IPL homes and in shells with their own time and weather set
MLO homes and gardens: during a power cut the lights you added go out, while the city's lights stay on
Placed doors can no longer be tipped over by pushing them or swung far past their normal opening angle
29 more doors in the Doors category can now be opened and locked; before they acted like plain furniture
The decoration category list now keeps the same order every time: the base categories first, then the prop packs from A to Z

entries.title: Security camera fixes and ambience for IPL homes

changes.text: IPL homes now have the Ambience tab in the M panel, so owners can set their own time and weather inside, like in shells
Editing a placed security camera now moves that camera itself, like furniture, instead of spawning a second one. Cancelling puts it back where it was
You now see your own character in camera views while you are inside the home
Security camera placement: the camera model is now changed with the left and right arrow keys or the previous and next buttons on the placement panel, instead of Tab
Manual camera placement: the mouse wheel turns the camera, the up and down arrows still tilt it
After watching an inside camera from outside, you are returned to where you stood instead of the door
Garden furniture and cameras no longer disappear while you watch the cameras

entries.title: New building system for apartments and motels, plus decoration favorites
files: cylex_apex_housing (replace the whole folder, then copy your config back)

changes.text: New building system for apartments and motels. It replaces the old apartment system: a building has floors and rooms, and rooms are created in batches from room types you set up once

Rooms are rented or sold per room type, with minimum and maximum rental days and a grace period. When a stay ends, stored items move to Lost Items, furniture is refunded minus a fee, and unpaid bills become a personal debt that must be paid before renting another room
Old apartment units are not converted. They can no longer be entered or previewed and their old stashes are not shown, so recreate them as a building

Two building modes: MLO buildings with real doors, and teleport buildings with IPL or shell rooms. Teleport buildings use either a door for each room or one single entrance through the intercom panel, chosen when the building is created
Free camera door editor for teleport buildings: place room doors floor by floor, copy a floor upwards and adjust the floor height with the arrow keys
MLO buildings: set up one room, then apply it to the other rooms as a template, with rotate and mirror
Intercom panel with a default reception NPC to list rooms, rent them and collect lost items. Elevators, room garages, doorbells and police raids also work in buildings

Decoration favorites: star any prop in the catalog and it appears in a Favorites tab next to All. Favorites are saved per character on the player's PC, and props removed from the config are no longer shown
A new building stays a draft in the panel and is only saved once its first rooms are created
ESC now hides the property creator instead of closing it, and /housing continues where you left off
The free camera for placing interior points in the property creator moves at half the speed for finer placement
Decoration catalog cards no longer stretch on pages with only a few items
The garage vehicle preview and retrieved vehicles now sit on the ground
Editing a property's zone no longer shows its own saved zone as a nearby conflict
Owner dashboard: recent activity now scrolls, key holders and the give key button are always reachable, and placed doors show their name instead of a model name
Saved housing data is loaded only after the database tables are ready, and data that cannot be read is no longer treated as empty and deleted
Players are returned to where they were when the resource restarts during property creation

MLO door locks now apply correctly for the player who created the property. Doors no longer stay unlocked (walkable and shown as unlocked) after a lock or an ownership change until you leave and re-enter the zone
Apartment complexes that have no units yet now appear in the /housing management list and can be deleted. Previously the terminal NPC stayed in the world with no way to remove it
Quickly locking and unlocking an MLO door can no longer leave it in the wrong state

entries.title: Redesigned interface, Discord logging and resource rename
files: cylex_apex_housing (replace the whole folder, then copy your config back)

changes.text: The whole interface has been redesigned with the new Cylex theme: owner panel, decoration, property creator, management, listings board, garage and door screens
The resource is now called cylex_apex_housing. Rename the folder and your ensure line; your database and property data are kept
Discord logging for admins with six channels (property, economy, keys, admin, upgrades, security). Every event includes copyable coordinates
New Settings tab in the owner panel: interface size, accent colour, glass or solid look, blur strength, alert options and per-property map blip
Shell properties can have a fixed time and weather from the new Ambience tab
Lights can now cycle through RGB colours
Furniture shows its name when you hover over it in decoration mode
Doors tab: lock or unlock every door at once. Cameras can now be moved
A small Cylex signature in the bottom-left corner of the panels. It follows the accent colour and can be turned off with Config.Branding.signature
Doorbell: only key holders near the property are notified, and a ring disappears for everyone once one of them answers
Panel open and close sounds have been removed. Click sounds remain
Dirt and the cleaning robot now stay in sync between players. The robot no longer spawns on MLO roofs or moves back and forth between two points
Doorbell spam protection now works correctly
The house garage no longer fails to hand over its keys
Vehicles stored in the garage can be taken out again after a house key has been handed over
Taking a vehicle out can no longer be triggered twice, either by double-clicking or by two players clicking at the same time
The cleaning robot no longer spawns two or three times in certain situations
All furniture is now cleared correctly when leaving a property that contains a large amount of interior furniture

entries.title: 4K scaling, police raid and key permissions

changes.text: The interface is now much larger on 2K and 4K displays, and a manual scale option has been added to the decoration menu settings
Police: a Raid button has been added to the [G] Inspect menu. It opens every door and stash in the property to the police for 10 minutes
Admins can no longer open house stashes directly
Key permissions now take effect immediately when they are changed
Key holders with the owner permission can now create lights
The light placement flow has been clarified so it is no longer confusing to add a light
The key prompt UI no longer breaks in certain situations
Players who have just been given a new key can now see the garage
Several optimizations have been made across the script

entries.title: Rebuilt gizmo and furniture editing settings

changes.text: Furniture editing now has its own settings, so you can fine-tune things like the freecam speed
X, Y and Z values can now be changed directly from the screen while placing an object
A new page has been added while moving an object
The For Sale sign is now functional
The gizmo has been rebuilt from scratch
The camera permission on keys now grants full camera access instead of only allowing cameras to be added
Island and building placement has been moved out of house creation into its own page under /housing, and now works correctly
The bills page is now paginated and easier to read instead of listing every bill at once
The mouse no longer jumps to the top left of the screen for some players
Objects that had been resized can now be selected with left click again
The UI no longer breaks when a light is confirmed with E while manual placement mode is active
The doorbell can be rung again after entering and leaving a property
Pressing E at the garage now opens the garage instead of doing nothing
A Lights page has been added to the property management panel. You can place lights anywhere inside the house or in the garden with the color, intensity and position you want
Permissions can now be selected in bulk while handing over a key
Moving, rotating and scaling furniture have been split onto three separate keys
The cleaning robot has been improved
Players no longer fall under the map when leaving a property
Cleaning a property manually now updates for everyone inside, not only for the player who cleaned it
A broken prop no longer freezes the game
Several garage issues have been fixed
